title: What's your dream job? 🤩🧑‍🚒🧑‍🚀 Real Easy English

sentences.en: Hello and welcome to Real Easy English, the podcast where we have real conversations in easy English to help you learn.
sentences.ko: 안녕하세요, Real Easy English에 오신 걸 환영해요. 쉬운 영어로 진짜 대화를 나누며 공부를 돕는 팟캐스트예요.

sentences.en: I'm Georgie.
sentences.ko: 저는 조지예요.

sentences.en: And I'm Neil.
sentences.ko: 그리고 저는 닐이에요.

sentences.en: To watch a video version of this podcast and download a free worksheet, go to our website, bbclearningenglish.com.
sentences.ko: 이 팟캐스트의 영상 버전을 보고 무료 학습지를 받으려면 웹사이트 bbclearningenglish.com에 가 보세요.

sentences.en: Hi Neil. How are you?
sentences.ko: 안녕, 닐. 잘 지내요?

sentences.en: Are you happy to be at work today?
sentences.ko: 오늘 출근해서 좋아요?

sentences.en: Of course. I'm always happy to be at work.
sentences.ko: 물론이죠. 저는 출근하면 늘 좋아요.

sentences.en: Great. Well, today we are talking about dream jobs.
sentences.ko: 좋아요. 자, 오늘은 꿈의 직업에 대해 얘기해요.

sentences.en: Obviously, this job is amazing, but we're going to talk about some different jobs we'd like to do.
sentences.ko: 당연히 이 일도 멋지지만, 해 보고 싶은 다른 직업들에 대해 얘기해 볼게요.

sentences.en: Sounds good. Shall we start?
sentences.ko: 좋네요. 시작할까요?

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.ko: 네.

sentences.en: So, Georgie, when you were a child, what did you want to do when you grew up?
sentences.ko: 조지, 어렸을 때 커서 뭐가 되고 싶었어요?

sentences.en: What was your dream job?
sentences.ko: 꿈의 직업이 뭐였어요?

sentences.en: Well, when I was really little, about five or six.
sentences.ko: 음, 정말 어렸을 때, 대여섯 살쯤에요.

sentences.en: I remember telling people that I wanted to be a princess.
sentences.ko: 사람들한테 공주가 되고 싶다고 말했던 게 기억나요.

sentences.en: When I realised that wasn't going to be possible for me, my next dream was to be a pop star, because my friends and I used to write songs and perform in front of our parents, and I thought that would be really fun.
sentences.ko: 그게 불가능하다는 걸 깨닫고 나서 다음 꿈은 팝 스타였어요. 친구들이랑 노래를 만들어서 부모님 앞에서 공연하곤 했는데, 그게 정말 재밌을 것 같았거든요.

sentences.en: Yeah. What about you?
sentences.ko: 네. 당신은요?

sentences.en: Well, I'm kind of similar.
sentences.ko: 음, 저도 좀 비슷해요.

sentences.en: I think, actually, when I was... when I was a child, I thought that being a professional sportsman would be fantastic – either a footballer or a cricketer.
sentences.ko: 사실 어렸을 땐 프로 운동선수, 축구 선수나 크리켓 선수가 되면 멋질 거라고 생각했어요.

sentences.en: What went wrong?
sentences.ko: 뭐가 잘못됐어요?

sentences.en: I'm not good enough!
sentences.ko: 실력이 부족했어요!

sentences.en: I learned that lesson.
sentences.ko: 그 교훈은 얻었죠.

sentences.en: But also, I wanted, when I got a little bit older, sort of teenage, and started playing guitar, I thought, yeah, maybe a rock star would be the thing for me.
sentences.ko: 그리고 좀 더 커서, 십 대쯤 기타를 치기 시작하면서, 그래, 어쩌면 록 스타가 나한테 맞겠다고 생각했어요.

sentences.en: So, Neil, obviously you are not a rock star, but how or when did you decide to become an English teacher instead?
sentences.ko: 닐, 당연히 록 스타는 안 됐는데, 대신 영어 선생님이 되기로 언제, 어떻게 결심했어요?

sentences.en: Well, when I finished university, I wanted to travel more than anything else.
sentences.ko: 음, 대학을 졸업했을 때 무엇보다 여행을 더 하고 싶었어요.

sentences.en: And I wanted to live in foreign countries, not just go on holiday.
sentences.ko: 그냥 휴가가 아니라 외국에서 살아 보고 싶었어요.

sentences.en: And I thought a good way to do that would be to become an English teacher.
sentences.ko: 그러려면 영어 선생님이 되는 게 좋은 방법이겠다고 생각했어요.

sentences.en: Yeah, I have a similar story.
sentences.ko: 네, 저도 비슷해요.

sentences.en: It was the same thing for me.
sentences.ko: 저도 똑같았어요.

sentences.en: I just wanted to live abroad.
sentences.ko: 그냥 해외에서 살고 싶었어요.

sentences.en: Georgie, what is important to you about your job now?
sentences.ko: 조지, 지금 일에서 중요하게 생각하는 건 뭐예요?

sentences.en: Well, many of us spend a lot of our lives working.
sentences.ko: 음, 우리 대부분은 인생의 많은 시간을 일하면서 보내요.

sentences.en: So, for me, it's really important to enjoy the day.
sentences.ko: 그래서 저한테는 하루를 즐기는 게 정말 중요해요.

sentences.en: We work nine to five.
sentences.ko: 9시부터 5시까지 일하잖아요.

sentences.en: It's a lot of hours in the day.
sentences.ko: 하루 중 많은 시간이에요.

sentences.en: It's really important to me to have a nice team that you can have fun with.
sentences.ko: 같이 즐겁게 지낼 수 있는 좋은 팀이 있는 게 저한텐 정말 중요해요.

sentences.en: It's also really important for me to feel like I'm giving something good or doing a good job.
sentences.ko: 그리고 뭔가 좋은 걸 주고 있다거나 일을 잘하고 있다고 느끼는 것도 정말 중요해요.

sentences.en: What about you?
sentences.ko: 당신은요?

sentences.en: Yeah, I think it's important to feel that you're doing something useful.
sentences.ko: 네, 쓸모 있는 일을 하고 있다고 느끼는 게 중요한 것 같아요.

sentences.en: So, hopefully our conversations like this are useful for people because they can learn something, and I like that.
sentences.ko: 그래서 이런 대화가 사람들이 뭔가 배울 수 있어서 쓸모 있었으면 좋겠어요. 그게 좋아요.

sentences.en: Yeah. Me too.
sentences.ko: 네. 저도요.

sentences.en: So, Neil, if you didn't have to worry about money or anything else, what would your dream job be?
sentences.ko: 닐, 돈이나 다른 걱정을 안 해도 된다면 꿈의 직업은 뭐예요?

sentences.en: I think I know the answer already.
sentences.ko: 답을 이미 알 것 같아요.

sentences.en: Yeah, well, you said earlier that I didn't become a rock star, but there is still a future.
sentences.ko: 네, 아까 제가 록 스타가 안 됐다고 했지만, 아직 미래가 있잖아요.

sentences.en: And, you know, if I didn't have to work, I could just follow my dream.
sentences.ko: 그리고 일을 안 해도 된다면 그냥 꿈을 따를 수 있겠죠.

sentences.en: How about you?
sentences.ko: 당신은요?

sentences.en: I think if I didn't do this job, I would like to be a travel photographer or someone that makes documentaries.
sentences.ko: 저는 이 일을 안 한다면 여행 사진작가나 다큐멘터리를 만드는 사람이 되고 싶어요.

sentences.en: I really love those nature documentaries, and it would be very fun to be involved in those.
sentences.ko: 자연 다큐멘터리를 정말 좋아해서, 그런 데 참여하면 정말 재밌을 것 같아요.

sentences.en: Yes, that sounds like it would be amazing.
sentences.ko: 네, 정말 멋질 것 같네요.

sentences.en: OK. Let's recap the language we heard during the conversation.
sentences.ko: 좋아요. 대화에서 들은 표현을 정리해 봐요.

sentences.en: We can describe something like a job as 'important to' us.
sentences.ko: 직업 같은 걸 우리에게 'important to'하다고 표현할 수 있어요.

sentences.en: For example, I said that a nice team at work is important to me.
sentences.ko: 예를 들어 저는 직장의 좋은 팀이 저한테 중요하다고 했어요.

sentences.en: We talked about our dream jobs when we were children using the structure 'when I was younger, I wanted to be...'
sentences.ko: 어렸을 때의 꿈의 직업은 'when I was younger, I wanted to be...' 구조로 얘기했어요.

sentences.en: So, for example, when I was younger I wanted to be a footballer.
sentences.ko: 예를 들면 'when I was younger I wanted to be a footballer.'

sentences.en: And we talked about our dream jobs now using conditionals.
sentences.ko: 그리고 지금의 꿈의 직업은 가정법으로 얘기했어요.

sentences.en: So, for example, if I 'could' do any job, I 'would' be a travel photographer.
sentences.ko: 예를 들면 'if I could do any job, I would be a travel photographer.'

sentences.en: And when we're talking about jobs, we can 'do' them, or we can 'be' them.
sentences.ko: 그리고 직업에 대해 말할 때 'do'를 쓸 수도 있고 'be'를 쓸 수도 있어요.

sentences.en: For example, I teach English, or I am an English teacher.
sentences.ko: 예를 들면 'I teach English', 또는 'I am an English teacher.'

sentences.en: And that's it for this episode of Real Easy English.
sentences.ko: Real Easy English 이번 에피소드는 여기까지예요.

sentences.en: If you like our programmes, why not sign up to our email newsletter?
sentences.ko: 저희 프로그램이 마음에 들면 이메일 뉴스레터를 신청해 보세요.

sentences.en: You can get suggestions for other English lessons you might enjoy.
sentences.ko: 좋아할 만한 다른 영어 수업을 추천받을 수 있어요.

sentences.en: There's a link in the notes for this programme.
sentences.ko: 이 프로그램 설명란에 링크가 있어요.

sentences.en: Join us again.
sentences.ko: 또 함께해요.

sentences.en: Bye!
sentences.ko: 안녕!
